name: Cognitavi
notes: Hyper-intelligent navigator birds. Subspecies include Vanga Pearl-Guide and Abyssal Storm-Watcher that aid seafarers.
journal_prompt: A navigator bird watches the water with its head tilted, reading something in it that you cannot, and does not much care that you are here.
appearance: An elegant, raven-sized bird with sleek, iridescent slate-grey plumage, a pronounced ivory casque above a sharp hooked beak, and luminous amber eyes marked with star-like pale flecks.
